【研究方法】In this 18-month, single-centre, open-label, pragmatic trial, 74 adults with stage 3-4 CKD and MA (serum bicarbonate < 22 mmol/L) were allocated in a 1:1:1 ratio to receive oral sodium bicarbonate (tablets or solution) or standard care (control).
